IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES;
END;

CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[Bank_Code] [varchar](5)  NULL,
	[Source_System] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[Data_Mart_Field] [varchar](35)  NULL,
	[BM_Field_Name] [varchar](35)  NULL,
	[Code] [varchar](12)  NULL,
	[Description] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
	
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO


IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC;
END;


CREATE TABLE
d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN)
AS
SELECT 	TOP 1
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES]
            WHERE H = 'D' and 1=2;

IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC;
END;


CREATE TABLE
d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_GROUP_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN)
AS
SELECT 	TOP 1
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CCD_PRODUCTCODES_SELECT_SRC
	WHERE 1=2
	GROUP BY     [Bank_Code]
				,[Source_System]
				,[Data_Mart_Field]
				,[BM_Field_Name]
				,[Code]
				,[Description]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP



CREATE TABLE [EDS].[CCD_PRODUCTCODES]
( 
	[Bank_Code] [varchar](5)  NULL,
	[Source_System] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[Data_Mart_Field] [varchar](35)  NULL,
	[BM_Field_Name] [varchar](35)  NULL,
	[Code] [varchar](12)  NULL,
	[Description] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [int]  NULL,
	[isLatest] [int]  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
)
GO
